title: Order of work: camera, geometry, poses, checker-clean, materials, light and grade
summary: Layout converges in 1-2 measured passes, poses ~5, light and grade ~10; scores sit at ~6 until poses are right. Order: camera, geometry, poses, checker-clean, materials, light, grade.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: dig: passes 1-8 geometry + poses (critic 6), 9-19 materials and light (critic 7)

doc.when: Planning any multi-pass scene build against a reference.
doc.avoid: Polishing materials while poses or geometry are off.

problem.symptom: Critic scores stall at ~6 despite material work.
problem.cause: Poses/geometry errors dominate the read; materials can't lift it.
problem.fix: Camera -> geometry (markers) -> poses (probe) -> checker clean -> materials -> lighting and grade.
problem.detect: Two critics in a row flag poses.
